caveats: ⚑ The whole HP-loss economy is derived, not simulated: v1 has no HP pool, so the S1 self-damage line is unmodeled as an effect and instead converted into landed-hit thresholds that stand in for the HP-gated S2 branch and the HP-gated burst branch.
⚑ skill2 block 2 ATK value (86.4) assumes HP-lost plateaus near 90% of Max HP; every point of that assumption is unmeasured.

⚑ skill2 block 2 gate (hitCount 450) and burst block 2 requiresPulls (750) both assume ~100% of normal attacks land and no ally healing restores HP; a healer in the comp pushes both gates later or shuts them off entirely.
⚑ Every hitCount threshold here is expressed in LANDED normal attacks; the wall-clock time to reach each one depends on the MG cadence tuple, which comes from a datamine-unreliable field.
⚑ Both burst hits are authored crit-eligible at the caster's sheet rate; the kit text does not state crit behaviour.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Electric MG Attacker, Burst III. S1: every 30 landed normal attacks, self Critical Rate ▲9.28% for 10s; the paired HP ▼2.01% self-cost has no representation (no HP pool at v1 scope) and is carried in `unmodeled`. S2 has two branches: every 150 landed normal attacks, self Critical Damage ▲14.69% for 5s; and an HP-gated ATK conversion (0.96% ATK per 1% Max HP lost) that opens once HP drops below 70%. That conversion is modeled as a self ATK buff opened by a landed-hit threshold, because HP loss in this kit is driven exclusively by S1: 30 landed hits cost 2.01% HP, so 30% HP lost = 15 S1 procs = 450 landed hits, and the buff then grows linearly with further hits — expressed as ⚑86.4% ATK (0.96 × an assumed ~90% Max-HP-lost floor) with a ⚑55s linear ramp from the gate. Burst is a single-target nuke on cast: 1237.5% of final ATK, plus a second 1237.5% hit that only lands once the caster's HP is under 50%, encoded as the same landed-hit proxy (50% lost = 25 S1 procs = 750 landed hits, hitsPerShot 1) via requiresPulls. Both burst hits are crit-eligible and take no core; burst-cast damage is full-burst-exempt by cast timing.
